answer: Resist sybils by selling scarce, non-transferable admission berths. A newcomer locks spendable stake to reserve a single harbor berth, then must finish uniquely salted audit tasks released on a jittered schedule so a bot farm cannot prefetch them. Until those audits clear, the identity lives in a reputation tundra: zero voting weight, one berth per hardware fingerprint, and a slash if two keys share a nonce. Influence unlocks only after a delayed signal from a random jury of established miners certifies that one key completed every audit and the berth stayed uncloned.
